# Alln1 Business

> Alln1 Business helps small businesses nationwide win more sales, run smarter marketing, stay active on social media and run on connected systems, all powered by AI.

Alln1 Business serves small businesses nationwide and is based in Houston, TX. Contact: Alln1 Business, Houston, TX, liz@alln1business.com, (281) 810-3315.

## Services

- [AI Audit & Roadmap](https://alln1business.com/ai-audit): For owners who want a practical plan before choosing tools or paying for a build. $497.

## Software workflows and accounting review designs

These are custom-build possibilities, not claimed tested demos or live deployments. Vendor API/plan access must be verified in the $497 AI Audit. AI drafts; a human approves every accounting entry before posting. A CPA reviews tax items. No autonomous payments or filing. Third-party software and usage costs are separate.

- [AI Workflows for Xero](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-xero): Prepare Xero bookkeeping inputs, organize invoice evidence and flag exceptions for human review. Custom integrations scoped around your account and API access.
- [AI Workflows for Jobber & Housecall Pro](https://alln1business.com/field-service-ai-workflows): Connect field-service intake, job paperwork and office handoffs around Jobber or Housecall Pro. API eligibility and human approval checked before a custom build.
- [AI Workflows for Shopify & WooCommerce](https://alln1business.com/ecommerce-ai-workflows): Prepare order exceptions, support drafts and payout bookkeeping reviews for Shopify or WooCommerce, with realistic API permissions and human approval.
- [Microsoft 365 AI Workflows](https://alln1business.com/microsoft-365-ai-workflows): Connect Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive and review queues using scoped Microsoft Graph access. Custom AI workflow design, not an unsupported Copilot promise.
- [Google Workspace AI Workflows](https://alln1business.com/google-workspace-ai-workflows): Organize Gmail, Drive and Sheets handoffs with consent, scoped APIs and reviewable AI drafts. Access and verification requirements checked before a build.
- [PO, Receipt & Invoice Matching](https://alln1business.com/ai-three-way-matching): Compare purchase orders, receiving evidence and supplier invoices in a human-reviewed exception queue. No automatic bill approval, payment or invented receipt data.
- [Chart-of-Accounts Cleanup Prep](https://alln1business.com/chart-of-accounts-cleanup): Find duplicate account labels and inconsistent coding, then prepare a bookkeeper-reviewed cleanup map. No automatic merges, deletions or historical reclassification.
- [Bank and card reconciliation preparation](https://alln1business.com/ai-month-end-close#bank-card-reconciliation): Authorized statement/export working papers, not automated bank reconciliation.
- [W-9 and 1099 readiness](https://alln1business.com/ai-tax-organizer#w9-1099-readiness): Restricted document-status tracking and CPA-reviewed evidence, not TIN verification or filing.

## AI by industry packages

Staged package roadmaps (starting out, growing, established). Each stage's "from" price is the published starting setup price of an existing Alln1 offer: AI-Ready Business Launch (Launch + AI Systems) from $3,997, AI Ops Infrastructure from $1,497, AI Revenue Systems from $2,497, AI Agent Systems from $3,500. Stages are alternative starting points, not cumulative tiers; exact scope follows the $497 AI Audit. Example stories on these pages are fictional. No client results, testimonials, partnerships, rankings or citations are claimed. Humans approve accounting entries, a CPA or authorized preparer reviews tax items, attorneys control legal work and confidentiality, and there are no autonomous payments or filings.

- [AI for Accounting & Bookkeeping Firms](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-accounting-firms): A staged AI package for bookkeeping and accounting firms: document chasing, close readiness, client questions and staff knowledge, with human review on every entry.
- [AI for Home Service Businesses](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-home-services): A staged AI package for HVAC, plumbing, electrical and roofing companies: answer every inquiry, book the estimate, follow up on quotes and request reviews, with people in charge.
- [AI for Construction & Real Estate Development](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-construction-development): A staged AI package for builders, contractors and real estate developers: job costs, vendor paperwork, COI tracking, meeting follow-through and owner visibility, with owner approval.
- [AI for Tax Preparation Firms](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-tax-firms): A staged AI package for tax preparers and small tax firms: document readiness, missing-item requests, status answers and secure handoff. Preparers review; no filing or tax advice by AI.
- [AI for Small Law Firms](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-law-firms): A staged AI package for solo and small law firms: answer inquiries, schedule consultations and handle admin follow-through. Attorneys control conflicts, legal work and confidentiality.

## Reading this site accurately

Service descriptions and example flows are proposed custom-build possibilities unless explicitly labeled otherwise. A video illustration is not proof of a tested or live deployment. Tests, launch permissions, review rules and optional support coverage are agreed in scope. Metadata and this file support discoverability; they do not guarantee search rankings, AI citations, traffic or revenue. The Book an AI Audit button opens an inquiry: Liz replies to arrange the audit; it does not reserve a calendar time or take payment.
